title: data for business.compliance_hold
description: Meshio suspended (state=active) or released (state=lifted) all sends of a business (customer) for compliance. Automatic holds come from Meta signals: account_update violation/restriction/ban/disable, 3+ templates paused in 7 days or 20+ Meta policy errors (131048, 131049, 368, 470) in 24 h; operators may also hold manually. While active, sends and new templates for the business are refused with 422 POLICY_BLOCKED (reason business_suspended) without calling Meta. Only a Meshio operator can lift a hold.
